card.title: THE GLAMOUR BOYS
card.flavorText: The 48th Highlanders of Canada, nicknamed “The Glamour Boys”, is a regiment of the Canadian Army. The regiment has been active from 1891 to the present day and has fought in the Second Boer War (1899-1901), WWI, WWII and the War in Afghanistan. In 1939 the regiment was sent to France as part of the Second British Expeditionary Force, but was soon ordered back to Britain. In 1943 the 48th Highlanders, as part of the 1st Canadian Infantry Division, landed in Sicily during Operation Husky, where it engaged in heavy fighting against the defending Axis forces. The 48th Highlanders then fought its way up the Italian peninsula, where it participated in the Battle of Ortona and the breaching of the Hitler Line defenses south of Rome. In March 1945, the regiment moved with the remainder of the I Canadian Corps to North-West Europe, where it fought until the end of the war.
